_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. The mutation vocabulary belongs to ONE subset of ONE standard of ONE artifact, so the (non-)oracle registration and the catalog live here. `s.note.note` is a semio-NATIVE artifact persisted as `.dsl.semio` text and `.pack.semio` binary through this subset's own codecs; no third party reads or writes either, so no oracle is registered — see noOracleDecisions below.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third-party library reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none could be authoritative over `NoteMutation` in any case: the 33 kinds ARE this subset's specification — 9 document-root scalars (the title plus the eight grid/snap/tool settings), 3 id-keyed image-asset kinds, and 21 kinds over an id-keyed, z-ordered, group-NESTABLE block tree whose leaves carry four different typed contents (text, math, ink strokes and tables). No external reader has a model of that tree to check ours against. What stands in its place is the committed, independently handcrafted `(before, mutation, after, diff, outcome)` specification vector under each of the 33 `🧬️mutations/<slug>/🧪️tests/<fixture>/` leaves — every one of which moves the document, which is not true of any other artifact covered in this wave — plus the inverse law as a metamorphic property: applying a kind and then its OWN computed inverse must restore the exact pre-mutation vector, POSITION in the block tree included and not merely membership.
